newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin rejects all bids in t-bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin rejects all bids in t-bill auction.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry on Wednesday rejected all bids in an auction of its three-week treasury bills, the first paper with such a maturity this year, the National bank of Slovakia (NBS) said.
The NBS said bids in the unsuccessful auction totalled 1.28 billion crowns.
Average yield in the last successful auction of similar bills on November 28 was at 10.414 percent.
Ministry officials were not immediately available for comment on the results of the auction.
